title: Temple of Laodike
description: A temple dedicated to Laodike III, wife of the Seleucid king Antiochos III, at Laodike / Nemavand in Media, which is known from epigraphic evidence. The structure has not been decisively located, but individual archaeological finds suggest that it was located in the northwest of modern Nahavand in the Dokhaharan suburb (between Kucheh Derazeh, Pa Qaleh Square, and Hosseinieh Dokhaharan)
